worldcombat.skill.trick.summary: Stretch a psychic thread to swap held items with the target from afar: you never have to move, only to see the target and reach it. An ally or an enemy can be chosen explicitly; aiming at empty space, a wall in the way or a target that left reach only snaps the thread without a swap. Quick individuals wind up faster; high Sp. Atk and level stretch the thread further.
worldcombat.skill.trick.use.0: Trade for a foe's good item from a distance
worldcombat.skill.trick.use.1: Hand a burden you carry to the foe
worldcombat.skill.trick.use.2: Swap gear with an ally, or take an item from a distant foe while empty-handed
worldcombat.skill.trick.description.0: Swap held items with a body within %1$s blocks and in clear sight, ally or enemy chosen explicitly: you stay put, and only when the atomic exchange really succeeds does each side hold what the other had (when one side is empty this is a one-way take or give) as the items fly along the thread.
worldcombat.skill.trick.description.1: A %1$s feint, %2$s to recover after the swap, and a %3$s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.trick.snap.on: Snap grab: wind-up x0.55 and 6 ticks less cooldown, at the cost of the thread closing to arm's reach (range x0.62) - faster, but you must be close.
worldcombat.skill.trick.snap.off: Measured thread: a longer thread (up to about 9 blocks) and a fuller cooldown, with a longer wind-up - more reach, but more time for the foe to react.
worldcombat.skill.trick.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it spends %4$s PP to stretch the thread, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.trick.growth.0: At level %1$s the thread stretches to %2$s blocks and the cooldown becomes %3$s seconds.
worldcombat.skill.trick.growth.1: At level %1$s the thread stretches to %2$s blocks and the feint shortens to %3$s seconds.
On: wind-up x0.55 and 6 ticks less cooldown, but the thread closes to arm's reach. Off: a longer thread with more reach, and a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.trick.preference.ai.ma: Only stretch the thread within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
worldcombat.skill.trick.preference.ai.le: On: it will leave its station under a hold order to stretch the thread. Off: it only casts when the target is already in reach.
worldcombat.skill.trick.preference.ai.tr: Only when there is an item to trade

On: only used when the target or the caster holds an item, as a dedicated trade. Off: it still only scores when there is something to trade and never wastes a cast with both sides empty. A known refusing target is never chosen.
worldcombat.skill.trick.description.cond: If the target ducks behind a wall, leaves reach or another body blocks the line after the wind-up, execution only snaps the thread without a swap. The swap happens when at least one side holds something and neither item channel is sealed; a target whose ability refuses held-item exchange cannot be traded with. Pointing at empty space or when both sides are empty-handed also misses and never fabricates an item.
